title: Product basis vectors are sign monomials
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every multi-index $a:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{0,1\}$, the product-basis vector indexed by $a$ equals the sign monomial on the set of coordinates where $a$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a map from the length-$n$ index set to the two-element index set
